description:
Earn yield on your Bitcoin. Supply sBTC from your Pillar smart wallet to Zest Protocol. Your sBTC earns interest with no leverage and no liquidation risk. This is the simplest way to earn on Pillar (Earn tab). For leveraged exposure, use pillar_boost instead.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount in satoshis to supply (optional, can be set in UI)
